title: Breakfast, promenade, Temple Street, Dim Sum Here, pool, checkout, lounge, airport
summary: Huge hotel breakfast, promenade walk, Temple Street to find Cynthia her bag, Dim Sum at Dim Sum Here, back to hotel for afternoon pool. Checkout at 18:00, lounge until taxi to airport for the late flight.

rows.detail: Walked up to Temple Street to find Cynthia her bag.

rows.what: Dim Sum at Dim Sum Here
rows.detail: Jordan / Temple Street area. Casual and good.
Just arrived back. Pool for the afternoon.
Until ready for the airport taxi.

From the hotel driveway. Show: 機場 一號客運大樓 國泰航空. 30 to 40 minutes at that hour, roughly HK$300 to 400 (est. A$54 to 73). Latest safe taxi 21:15. Backup: the Airport Express from Kowloon Station (How-to 37).

rows.what: Check in at the Cathay desks

rows.detail: Saturday 31 October, Terminal 1. Lands Melbourne Terminal 2 at 12:30.

notes: Skipped Big Buddha. Did promenade, Temple Street bag shopping, Dim Sum Here, then pool afternoon.
A taxi at 21:15 puts you at the airport by 22:00, which is 2.5 hours before departure.
